# Nibleaf

> Nibleaf is an open-source, self-hostable documentation platform — a Mintlify/GitBook alternative you run on your own infrastructure. Write docs in Markdown/MDX, get a fast, searchable site with versioned publishing, custom domains, and first-party analytics. Bilingual English/Arabic with first-class right-to-left (RTL) support. Deploy the whole stack with one Docker command. Licensed AGPL-3.0.

## Key facts
- Self-hostable via a single `docker compose up -d` (app, API, worker, Postgres, Redis-compatible cache, S3-compatible storage)
- Own your data: content, search index, analytics, and readers stay in your database and storage
- WYSIWYG + Markdown editor that round-trips MDX components (callouts, cards, steps, tabs, code groups, accordions, params, math, Mermaid)
- Versioned publishing: every publish is an immutable snapshot; rollback is atomic
- Hybrid full-text + fuzzy search powered by Orama, built into every published site (bilingual, incl. an Arabic tokenizer)
- Arabic-ready, RTL-first bilingual authoring and reading
- Free and open source (AGPL-3.0); managed Nibleaf Cloud is coming soon

## Comparison
- Nibleaf vs Mintlify / GitBook / ReadMe: the same polished authoring experience, but open source, self-hostable, and with no per-seat lock-in.
